newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Yachting: Peter Campbell's Rhumbline Column.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Yachting: Peter Campbell's Rhumbline Column.

text.p: WHO'S MINDING THE OFFICE WHILE WE GO TO SEA?

Several of Sydney's prominent corporate executives who enjoy ocean yacht racing as their break away from the office are heading offshore tomorrow in Middle Harbour Yacht Club's traditional end-of-season rock-hopping race up the New South Wales North Coast from Sydney to Mooloolaba.

CHARLES CURRAN, chairman of Capital Investments and a partner with yacht designer IAIN MURRAY in the boat-building company Bashford International, will be skipper his MURRAY-designed 60-footer Sydney in the 469 nautical mile autumn
